name: colWeightedVars
title: Weighted variance and weighted standard deviation

origin.description: Computes a weighted variance for each column of a matrix.
origin.usage:
colWeightedVars(x, w = NULL, rows = NULL, cols = NULL, na.rm = FALSE,
  ..., useNames = TRUE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric matrix. A vector has no dimension and is rejected.

arguments.name: w
arguments.text: A vector of weights, one per row. None gives every row weight 1. rows indexes this vector with base R rules.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: A vector indicating subset of rows to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: A vector indicating subset of columns to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If TRUE, missing values are excluded.

arguments.name: useNames
arguments.text: If TRUE (default), names attributes of the result are set, otherwise not.

origin.details: Each selected column is passed to weightedVar. The matrix is indexed with rows and cols. w is then indexed with the original rows.
origin.value: A numeric vector of length equal to the number of selected columns.

translation.description: Computes a weighted variance for each column of a matrix.
translation.usage:
colWeightedVars(x, w=None, rows=None, cols=None, na_rm=False,
  center=None, use_names=True)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A 2-d numeric array whose axis 0 is rows and axis 1 is columns, matching the printed R matrix.

arguments.name: w
arguments.text: One weight per row. None gives every row weight 1. rows indexes w with vector rules.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: 1-based row subscripts. None selects every row.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: 1-based column subscripts. None selects every column. A positive index past the end is an error.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: If True, missing values in a column are skipped. This is na.rm in R.

arguments.name: center
arguments.text: Optional center passed to every column. None estimates the center on that column.

arguments.name: use_names
arguments.text: Accepted for the R argument useNames. The result is a plain float64 vector, with no names attached.

translation.details: Each column uses the weightedVar estimator. The divisor is sum(w) - 1 after that column's own weight filter.
translation.value: A float64 vector with one value per selected column.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from matrixstats.weightedvar import colWeightedVars

colWeightedVars(np.arange(1, 13, dtype=float).reshape((3, 4), order="F"))
